answer: Make every new agent identity post a slashable bond before it may attest or be graded. A Sybil farm of ten thousand sock puppets then needs ten thousand simultaneous stakes locked in treasury, not ten thousand free signups. Each fraudulent attestation is independently slashed, so one bad batch burns the stake behind every sable alias. The attacker's ledger becomes a glacier of frozen collateral that thaws only if honest grading pays out, and expected profit stays far from its zenith until bond plus slashing risk drops below reward per identity. Capital lockup, not captcha, is the brake.
